title: Input Validation Issue in Admin iframe Could Result in Staff Account Takeover
summary:
### Impact

An input validation vulnerability allowed anybody with the ability to publish content on the public site to take over a staff user's account. Exploitation required an active staff user to visit the malicious page.

### Vulnerable versions

This vulnerability is present in Ghost from v5.8.0 up to v6.34.0.

### Patches

v6.34.0 contains a fix for this issue.

### How to update

For self-hosters using Docker, find [Docker's official Ghost image here](https://hub.docker.com/_/ghost). Updating a Docker-based Ghost instance [is documented here](https://docs.ghost.org/install/docker#updating-ghost). 

If your Ghost is a Ghost-CLI install see our documentation on [updating it to the latest version here](https://docs.ghost.org/update). 

### References

We thank Jorian Woltjer of Aikido Security for disclosing this vulnerability responsibly.

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory, email us at [security@ghost.org](mailto:security@ghost.org).
